SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) dist_ids, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  min(r.quantity_returned) minq, max(r.quantity_returned) maxq, sum(case when r.quantity_returned<=0 then 1 else 0 end) nonpos,
  sum(case when r.refund_net=0 then 1 else 0 end) zero_refund
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture'

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.*, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS ver_sub, p.sku, s.store_id,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date,
         sl.quantity AS sold_qty, sl.sale_date, sl.product_key AS sold_pk
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  WHERE (cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')
    AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-08-31' OR CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-08-31')
)
SELECT
  count(*) rows_, count(distinct return_line_id) ids, count(distinct sales_line_id) sl_ids,
  sum(case when return_date<>hel_date then 1 else 0 end) date_mismatch,
  sum(case when return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' then 1 else 0 end) by_return_date,
  sum(case when hel_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' then 1 else 0 end) by_hel_date,
  sum(case when cur_sub<>ver_sub then 1 else 0 end) sub_differs,
  sum(case when store_id=999 then 1 else 0 end) s999,
  sum(case when store_id=900 then 1 else 0 end) s900,
  sum(case when sold_qty IS NULL then 1 else 0 end) orphan,
  sum(case when quantity_returned>sold_qty then 1 else 0 end) over_ret,
  sum(case when return_date<sale_date then 1 else 0 end) before_sale
FROM r

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, wo.status, wo.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
  (SELECT string_agg(fiscal_period_label||':'||fully_loaded, ',') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cal
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id=sl.receipt_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3
